title: Measure selection breadth
brief: Compare selective and broad work without treating one timing as truth.
instructions: Return order_id for customer_id = 42 in the primary query.
Return order_id for customer_id <= 900 in the secondary query.
Use the isolated dataset without a secondary index.
Measure one warmup per query and nine alternating timing pairs.
Select the measured medians and MADs into your report.
Report the lower median, or equal.
Report whether the median difference exceeds the sum of both MADs.
No hardware-dependent speed threshold determines completion.
starterSql: SELECT order_id, customer_id FROM lookup_orders LIMIT 10;
starterExplanation: The starter shows lookup identities before either filter. Correctness is separate from the measured median and median absolute deviation.

hints.text: Compare different selectivity with repeated paired measurements.
Keep both projections at order identity and alternate the sample order.
A broad result can be slower because it transfers more rows. A single fast sample does not establish a stable difference.
